text:
tyler: Heads-up: opened docs PR #4921 for the April patch. It includes release notes + model-catalog updates to mark redwood-lite-0.9 deprecated and add migration guidance. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921
nina: Thanks. I can review migration flow. Quick ask: do we want a code snippet showing both JS & Python pin examples?
kevin: Yes please. Also I'll run the snippet smoke tests once the preview is available.
doc-ci: preview build queued for PR #4921 -> job docs-preview-78. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/9938
rachael: Small content note: the deprecation wording currently says "will be removed soon" 1 1. Can we be more specific: "scheduled for removal in v1.0.0 (expected June 15)"? saves customer questions.
tyler: Good call. I'll update to include the expected removal date and a link to the migration guide page.
doc-ci: docs-preview-78 failed lint: broken link in /model-catalog/redwood-lite-0.9 -> returned 404. Full log: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/9938/logs/failed_links.txt
kevin: That broken link is to an internal staging asset. Quick fix: point catalog entry to the canonical model page `/models/redwood-lite-compat` instead of the old path. Pushing patch.
doc-ci: rebuild triggered, docs-preview-79 started.
doc-ci: docs-preview-79 succeeded. Preview: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/4921 (expires in 24h)
nina: Reviewed migration prose. Left two tiny inline comments: clarify "compat" -> "compatibility model" and add a short note about expected quality differences. Otherwise LGTM.
kevin: Running snippet tests: js-snippet OK, python-snippet failing with formatting error (indentation in fenced block). I'll push a formatting fix.
tyler: Also added a short migration checklist for customers which shows steps: 1) pin model, 2) run smoke prompts, 3) report regressions to support.
site-bot: staging deploy started for commit 4c9d2f1 (docs-preview). Job: preview-deploy-801.
rachael: Can we gate the deprecation announcement behind feature flag `docs_show_deprecations`? Some customers still on older SDKs and I'd like to avoid confusion until we publish the SDK compatibility note.
tyler: Sure — I moved the deprecation callout behind an include that checks `docs_show_deprecations`. Default OFF. I'll flip it when we're ready to announce (planned 2026-04-25 15:00 PT).
ops-oncall: Note: if we publish during the announced window, have runbook ready in case of spike to support. Keep me in the loop.
doc-ci: smoke checks completed: no broken links, accessibility check passed.
kevin: Snippet formatting fixed and tests passing.
rachael: Approving the migration content (after the date and feature-flag note).
tyler: Thanks all. Merge plan proposal: 1) merge docs PR with feature-flag OFF, 2) wait 5m for preview & smoke checks, 3) flip `docs_show_deprecations` ON and clear cache, 4) post release note in #release-notes at publish time. Who will perform step 3?
nina: I can flip the flag and watch for cache invalidation. Available at 15:00 PT.
kevin: I'll monitor the SDK snippets and quick smoke prompts after the flag flip.
doc-ci: merging PR #4921 via squash commit. Commit id: a8f4d2b
site-bot: publish started for commit a8f4d2b -> job publish-412.
doc-ci: post-merge checks OK. No regressions.
tyler: Flipped `docs_show_deprecations` ON at 15:00 PT and invalidated CDN cache.
nina: Live preview looks correct. The deprecation callout appears and migration snippets show both JS & Python.
ops-oncall: Monitoring support queues.
kevin: Quick production sanity: executed the JS pin example `await client.text.generate({model: "redwood-lite-compat"})` and a few sample prompts, responses look within expected bounds.
rachael: Posting final note: added a short Q/A to the migration page addressing common upgrade questions.
tyler: Closing loop: PR #4921 merged, flag flipped, docs published. Filing a small follow-up PR to add an automated compatibility badge. Thanks everyone.
site-bot: publish completed successfully (publish-412)"
